title: The Hearing Aid Effectiveness After Aural Rehabilitation (HEAR) Trial
brief_summary: This study compares the effectiveness of hearing aid appointments provided in a group format to those provided in an individual format. We are asking if hearing aid training with group appointments is as good as or better than with individual appointments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

New hearing aid users at VA Puget Sound; eligible for VA hearing aids

Exclusion Criteria:

Prior hearing aid users; Inability to participate in a group rehabilitation sessions or to complete follow-up
